title: The desk's 'One more card set' (after the Daily 15 is done) rates cards on FSRS but logs no ledger entry and pays nothing; its end screen repeats the first set's '+N XP'
detail: Finish the Daily 15's reviews, go back to the Mind desk, press the Daily card's 'One more card set' (shown while cards are still due). The run opens via KOS.show('mind',{page:'daily',mode:'cards'}), which resets d.results but leaves d.logged = true from the first set, so onFinish's `if (d.results.length && !d.logged)` never calls finishReviews. Empty account (27 cards due, Exam Season on): first set 15 × Again → one entry {cards 15, passed 0, pay 0}; desk 'One more card set' → 10 × Good → ledger unchanged (still one entry), d.paid 0, governor XP 0; should be a second entry {cards 10, passed 10, pay 10}. Dense account (18 due): first set 15 Good → entry {cards 18…, pay 15}; desk extra set 3 × Good → no entry, and the done screen reads 'Reviews +15 XP' (the first set's d.paid). The FSRS schedules and the review log move, so the reviews happened but the ledger (study streak activity, Mind goals, Reports) never sees them and the +1 XP a passed card under the 15 cap is lost. The in-page 'One more card set' on the done screen does reset d.logged (mind.js:891) and works. Reproduced on dense and empty, mac.
rootCause: js/modules/mind.js:696 — the mode 'cards' entry resets d.step/d.extra/d.results but not d.logged (nor d.paid); onFinish at js/modules/mind.js:781-784 gates finishReviews on !d.logged; done() at :887 prints the stale d.paid
evidence: eval (empty, slot 4): after set 1 ledger [[2026-11-27,15,0,0,0]]; after desk extra set of 10 Good: d.results 10, d.logged true, d.paid 0, ledger still [[2026-11-27,15,0,0,0]], governor.xp 0. Dense: extra set of 3 → ledger unchanged [[2026-11-27,18,18,15,15]], #main 'Done for today. 1 minute: 3 cards. Reviews +15 XP'
fix: Make line 696 the same reset as the in-page button: `d.results = []; d.logged = false; d.paid = 0;` (better: one helper `extraSet(d)` used by both entry points), so every card set ends in its own finishReviews entry under the 15 XP cap (invariant 137, 5).

title: Daily 15 and #/mind/cards: the shared session's '↺ Restart' re-asks cards already rated today, re-rates them on FSRS and counts them twice in the one ledger entry
detail: In the Daily 15 reviews (dense, 15 due), rate 3 Good, press ↺ Restart: the run starts again at 'Question · 15 left of 15' with the same first card. Rating 2 more pushes argument:1 and soundness:1 into d.results a second time and re-rates them (argument:1 reps 1→2, ivl 2, same day). Finishing the run logged ONE entry {cards: 18, passed: 18, pay 15} for 15 distinct cards, and the done screen says '18 cards'. Pay is capped at 15 a day, so it overpays only under the cap (5 due → Restart → 10 'passed', +10 XP instead of +5), but the card count reaching goals and Reports is wrong, and a second same-day FSRS rating moves the schedule twice. The same holds for #/mind/cards (same session, results array in the closure). Shuffle is harmless. Reproduced twice (mac, dense).
rootCause: js/engines/flashcards.js:474-485 restart() rebuilds the queue from the card list given at draw time; Mind's callers (js/modules/mind.js:766-786 Daily, :985-1015 cards page) pass that list once and push every onRate into results without de-duplicating; finishReviews (js/core/mind.js:285-293) counts graded.length
evidence: eval (dense): d.results keys ['argument:1','soundness:1','standard-form:1','argument:1','soundness:1'] after Restart; final ledger [2026-11-27, cards 18, passed 18, pay 15]; d.results 18 entries, 15 distinct; #main 'Done for today. 1 minute: 18 cards.'
fix: For Mind's runs pass a `noRestart` option (or have restart() drop cards already rated in this run: filter `mine`), and make finishReviews count distinct keys (last grade wins) so one sitting can never count a card twice.
phase1: Neon ux-polish T3 (29ee1108) — the Daily's reviews moved onto KOS.flashcards.session, which brought Restart

title: #/mind/cards: a reload, a closed tab or an iPad killing the app mid-run loses the run's ledger entry — the cards are rescheduled but never logged or paid
detail: Open 'Review my Mind cards (N due)', rate some cards, then reload (or close the tab / let iPadOS evict the PWA). The ratings already moved FSRS (rateCard saves at once) but the run's results live only in the render's closure and are logged by KOS.view.onDispose or the ✕ button — neither runs on unload. Empty account (13 XP of headroom under the 15 cap): 4 × Good → due 27→23, reload → ledger unchanged ([15,0,0],[2,2,2]), governor XP 2 → 2 (should be one entry {cards 4, passed 4, pay 4} and +4 XP). Dense: 4 × Good then reload → 7 cards moved, no entry for the 4. Coming back starts a fresh run ('Question · 11 left of 11') with no 'Picked up where you left off'. Related to SY-34 (a redraw splits the run in two — re-confirmed: rate 3, KOS.rerender() → entry {cards 3} and 'Question · 15 left of 15'), but this is the loss case, and it is the common way an iPad session ends. The Daily 15 keeps its results in state.ui.mind.daily and survives a reload. Reproduced twice (dense, empty; mac).
rootCause: js/modules/mind.js:957-965 — results/logged live in cardsPage's closure; finishOnce is registered only with KOS.view.onDispose (not run on pagehide/unload) and the ✕ button; the session runs with runKey null and noSessionLog (mind.js:986-991), so neither KOS.sessions.run nor KOS.sessions.upsert keeps anything
evidence: eval (empty, slot 4): before reload ledger reviews [[15,0,0],[2,2,2]], due 23 after 4 rated; after location.reload(): same ledger, governor.xp 2, paidToday 2. Dense: after reload 7 cards due > today, ledger reviews [[18,15],[3,0]] only (the 3 from the SY-34 redraw)
fix: Log the run as it goes, as the shared engine does for every other deck (invariant 167): give the Mind session a runKey ('mind:cards:<day>') and log through KOS.sessions.upsert with metrics.kind 'reviews' and pay by difference under the cap — or at least keep results in state.ui.mind (like the Daily's d.results) and finish an unlogged run on the next Mind open. This also fixes SY-34.
phase1: 1E mind#3 (328e6856) and its merge onto the shared session (bb7144ac)

title: Daily 15 reviews: after a reload or any redraw mid-run the 'capped at 15' run grows past 15 — the cards beyond the cap slide into the queue
detail: Dense, 18 cards due, Exam Season: the intro says '15 cards due · capped at 15' and the run starts 'Question · 15 left of 15'. Rate 5, reload (or any KOS.rerender of the page): the run comes back as 'Question · 13 left of 13', so the sitting becomes 5 + 13 = 18 cards. The progress pips restart at 13 and the run is no longer the 4–5 minutes the plan promised. Reproduced twice (dense, mac: once after a reload, once after a Chrome restart with the run in state.ui).
rootCause: js/modules/mind.js:763 — reviews() rebuilds the queue as M().due(t) (the first 15 cards CURRENTLY due) minus d.results; the cards already rated are no longer due, so cards 16+ take their place. The cap is applied to what is due now, not to the sitting.
evidence: eval (dense, slot 4): d.results 5 after reload, #main fc.count 'Question · 13 left of 13'; KOS.mind.due(today,true).length 13 before the reload
fix: Cap the queue by what the sitting has left: `queue.slice(0, Math.max(0, M().DAILY_CARDS - d.results.length))` unless d.extra; or freeze the day's queue in d.queue when the run starts.

title: A lesson's Cards tab is now a live FSRS review with no ledger entry: rating there schedules cards of a lesson not yet finished, ticks 'First retrieval passed' and Recall, and logs and pays nothing
detail: Phase 1 turned the lesson Cards tab from a read-only list into KOS.flashcards.mount over the Mind SRS adapter. Empty account, F1.6 not started (0 of 6 pages, check 0 of 3), its concept's cards not yet introduced: Cards tab → Study shows 'Question · 2 left of 2', '2 new'; rating both Good creates charity:0/1 (adapter's rate() calls M().introduce), schedules them (due 29 Nov, reps 1), sets the shared progress check 4 'First retrieval passed' (progress [false,false,false,true]) and the Recall rung — while the inspector still says 'cards from tomorrow' and the Deck tab says 'These join your reviews the day after you finish the lesson.' No ledger entry is written (sessions +0, XP +0), so these reviews never count as study activity, never reach Mind goals or Reports, and never get the +1 XP a passed card that invariant 137 gives a review block; the engine's end card says 'check Due Today tomorrow', but Mind cards are not in Due Today. The same rating done in the Daily 15 or #/mind/cards is one paid entry. Reproduced twice (F1.6 on empty after deleting its cards; and the dense F1.1 tab re-rating already scheduled cards, ledger unchanged).
rootCause: js/modules/mindtopic.js:375-392 — renderCards mounts the shared engine with noSessionLog: true, runKey: null and no onFinish → finishReviews; js/modules/mind.js:943-948 (mindSrs().rate) introduces the concept on first rating whatever the lesson's state; the end-card hint is fixed text in js/engines/flashcards.js:454
evidence: eval (empty, slot 4): before {checks [F,F,F,F], ladder charity [F,F,F,F], no charity cards}; after rating 2 Good: cards charity:0/1 due 2026-11-29 reps 1, evidence checks [F,F,F,T], peekProgress check [F,F,F,T], ladder [T,F,F,F], finished false, ledger +0, XP +0. Screenshot /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/mind/lesson-cards-mac-empty.png
fix: Pick one meaning and say it: either (a) keep the tab as review — log it like the cards page (finishReviews on finish, through the same run record as MI-22) and only offer the session once the lesson is finished (before that, the Deck list with 'from tomorrow'); or (b) make it practice — a self-marked run that moves no schedule (like the checkpoint's cards) and say so. Pass an end-card hint through opts so Mind's says 'They come back in your Daily 15'.
phase1: Neon ux-polish T3 (29ee1108) — the Cards tab on KOS.flashcards.mount
